_comment: I0 provider playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). Public facts only, every claim sourced. No public law-enforcement or freeze-request channel was found for FDUSD (the issuer's legal pages refuse automated reads): no channel is declared and none may be guessed. FD121 freezes on a formal directive from a recognised authority with jurisdiction over FDUSD, or at its own discretion for compliance / risk.
notes: Issuer FD121 Limited: described as a Hong Kong company (Dec 2024 review); the issuer announced a move to a BVI-based issuance structure in Aug 2025 (page not machine-readable when checked), so which authority has jurisdiction is unsettled: no issuer jurisdiction is set. The contract has a single owner account that can freeze and pause transfers; the freeze function and event names are not verified, and app/freeze does not read FDUSD, so a person confirms a freeze on the explorer. FDUSD liquidity sits mostly on large exchanges: pursue the off-ramp exchange in parallel.
